worker_claim.report: Focused containment, launcher, recovery, worker-process, worker-supervisor, and launcher tests pass; Ruff and diff checks pass.
worker_claim.summary: Defined the mandatory production containment composition point and replaced the source-path launcher with an isolated, package-independent trusted joiner using Python -I -S. Preserved cgroup-authoritative retirement and diagnostics-only legacy identity handling, and removed the obsolete detached-descendant fallback regression while adding launcher startup-hook and standalone-path coverage.
